# Test PDF corpus

Per Blueprint v2, Section 11.2, this directory should contain:

- [ ] A large (500+ page) PDF
- [ ] An encrypted/password-protected PDF
- [ ] A corrupted/malformed PDF
- [ ] A scanned image-only PDF (for OCR testing)
- [ ] A form-heavy AcroForm PDF
- [ ] A PDF with non-Latin fonts
- [ ] A real anonymized architectural drawing set from an HSA project (client-sensitive info removed), for realistic AEC testing

None of these are checked in yet — collecting them is a Phase 0 action item that needs real files, not something an agent can fabricate. Add each fixture as it's sourced and check this list off.
